scope: The refund conversation, six model-selected calls, operator action, native Symfony Profiler panels and two model answers come from one recorded Symfony AI conversation. Requests and results are typeset for readability. The browser insert inspects an original Profiler export from this conversation. The closing command runs a separate deterministic PHP MCP client proof.

agentRecording.editorialSelection: The first take found the group and continued with individual readers. This take tried the group name as a reader, opened the group through search_tools, read the order and its named policy, and retried the policy after revocation.

screenRecordingEdit.source: Local Chrome recording of native Symfony Profiler HTML generated for request 4 of this agent conversation. The browser scrolls to the returned definitions and expands refund_get_order.
screenRecordingEdit.endHold: Final browser frame held to the cut.

segments.title: Which tools does your team use together?
segments.source: Editorial opening and the two readers from the captured group response.

segments.title: Give the agent a refund to review
segments.source: Excerpt from the recorded first user turn.

segments.title: Find the refund group
segments.source: Model-selected query, returned group, and the separate denied attempt at 25.3 seconds to execute refund-review as a reader.

segments.title: Open the team’s procedure
segments.source: The model opened the group with search_tools. Its native Symfony Profiler panel and the returned order reader schema appear on screen.

segments.title: Read order R-1042
segments.source: Recorded execute_tools reader arguments, euro amount, age, condition and returned policy ID.

segments.title: Follow the order’s policy ID
segments.source: Recorded execute_tools reader arguments and the standard-eu policy result.

segments.title: Send the €75 refund for manual review
segments.source: The first model answer and the amounts from the two reads.

segments.title: Revoke access and ask again
segments.source: Operator grant change and the verbatim second user turn.

segments.title: Inspect the denied policy read
segments.source: The new policy call returned tool_denied with zero completed calls and no native handler events. The quote comes from the second model answer.

segments.title: Replay the requests
segments.source: The independent released PHP MCP client reproduces discovery, both reads and denial. It also searches again after revocation.
